page: Microsoft Azure M176bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 176 vCPUs across 88 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz and features a 105 MB L3 cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

This server is configured with 3892.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 22.11 GB of memory per core. It features 8192 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable, though it does not include any GPUs. The system runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance across multiple domains. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression both rank in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only cached small block bandwidth reaching 11,574.6 GB/sec and uncached large block write bandwidth at 186.0 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations show exceptional throughput, with Redis achieving 169.15 million operations per second. Additionally, the server demonstrates strong capabilities in CPU-based LLM inference, particularly in prompt processing for large 70B models.

Given its massive memory footprint, high core count, and substantial local storage, the M176bds_4_v3 offers high resource density suitable for enterprise-grade workloads. It is highly optimized for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy database operations, data warehousing, and demanding multi-threaded enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure M176bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 176 vCPUs and 88 physical cores running at 4.0 GHz, it features 3892.0 GB of RAM and 8192 GB of local storage. The server excels in multi-core processing and memory throughput, achieving top-tier benchmark results in database operations, Redis transactions, and multi-threaded decompression. It supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX, making it highly capable for complex mathematical and vector operations. Without dedicated GPUs, it relies on its massive CPU and memory capacity to handle demanding tasks. This configuration is best suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise ERP systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
